newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian rebels shell house, five injured.
newsitem.headline: Colombian rebels shell house, five injured.

text.p: Leftist rebels fired mortar rounds into a home in Colombia's main oil town on Thursday, seriously injuring at least five people, army sources said.
National Liberation Army (ELN) guerrillas fired shells from a 70-millimetre mortar that hit a house four blocks away in the northeastern town of Barrancabermeja, an army spokesman said.
Two men, two women and a 9-year-old child were wounded, the spokesman said.
It was not immediately clear whether the house was the rebels' intended target.
The ELN specialises in attacks on Colombia's key oil infrastructure.
